notes.title: Gods of Havoc - Trilogy
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35397735/784fd00bc6fd1e4322fac50b082b368a3687936b.png[/img]

[h1]Gods of Havoc heralds a return to the classic God-Game.[/h1]

Gods of Havoc is a three-part series offering difficult, turn-based strategy. Each game places the player as a god in different eras of a planet’s history.
 
[list]
[*] Fall to Earth: takes place in an early medieval setting;
[*] After the Fall: takes place in a post-apocalyptic one;
[*] Into the Void: takes place in a galactic scale.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117340/Gods_of_Havoc_Into_the_Void/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120770/Gods_of_Havoc_Fall_to_Earth/
 
‘Fall to Earth’ and ‘Into the Void’, are set to be released in August 2019 with ‘After the Fall’ to be released in December 2019.

Don't forget to wishlist for more news on all three games! Visit https://www.gods-of-havoc.com/ for more information!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
Firstly I'd like to apologize for the huge delay between patches. I don't want to bore you with my life but I've had some heart wrenching issues with family that meant that work got completely overlooked. However, though those issues are not sorted I am back in a smaller capacity and will be releasing the arena content patch within a few weeks. This patch clears up a lot of lag issues on certain PCs and was created by a fellow RPG Maker. In return I have agreed to help promote her Greenlight. It's made in the new MV and looks amazing, please give it a like.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=735825714

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.7 - New vendor and fixes
notes.content:
* A new vendor at the adventurers market which sells some rare ingredients, ores, and crystal dust.

* Some grammar and spelling fixes.
* Number input won't crash during day over.
* Child will no longer glitch during rain.
* Various AI tweaks.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.5 - Autoloot corpses
notes.content:
Sorry for the multiple patches but we've had differnt people working on different fixes/content. This one has been much requested and I thought deserved to be uploaded straight away and not in the next batch.

* The gold and items dropped by enemies will now be picked up when you walk over them. No more need to press space/enter. This does not work for normal lootables (chests or nests), only for enemy drops.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.4 - Mini Content Patch (Shadow Familiar)
notes.content:
Adds a small new room underneath the chapel where the strange black pillars suck away at your skill points in order to feed the Shadow Familiar.

* Sacrifice your skill points to grow the Shadow Familiar.
* Grow them through six evolutions.
* Take them with you on adventures.
* Grow the most powerful companion in the game to date.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.3 - Teleport Stone and Bigfixes
notes.content:
Content:

* A stone in portal grove that, once activated, allows you to teleport to the grove from any location.

Changes:

* Visiting priests, heroes, cooks, and foragers now stay for longer periods.
Fixes:

* Prayers for Magic now grant magic rather than health
* Guests now report correctly on the state of the Arcus portal.
* Gun ammo should now always work
* The text [spoiler]where the guard speaks to you after Arcus[/spoiler] has fone through qq, don't know how we missed that.
* You can no longer walk through the fireplace in the tavern

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.2 - Code optimizations - simplified hud
notes.content:
I know some of you are still experiencing lag and hopefully this patch will go some way to reducing that. This morning, 3 of the 8 machines we ordered (ones with similar hardware to those having lag issues) arrived. This patch fixed the issue on two of them. Hopefully this will solve the problem for at least the same ratio of other machines out there.

Patch Contains:

* Code optimization
* Simplified Hud - magic is only really used from the menu so the magic bar was removed and the date and silver moved over tp the left box. (this also may help with lag issues)
* Old code removed
* Various small bug fixes.

notes.title: Lag Hotfix
notes.content:
Some machines have reported lag, regardless of hardware. After some tinkering and help from Squamousness, we have isolated the issue. 

Under the main menu, there is now the option to turn effects on/off - previously this menu item only controlled weather but now it also includes the advanced lighting.  This should deal with the problem for now until we can further investigate that part of the game.

notes.title: Beta Patch 0.9.3 - Paying Your taxes
notes.content:
Introduces the Royal Tax-Collector.

* Tax collection occurs 3 times per month
* Lower your taxes by:
     - Offering the taxman quality food at the tavern.
     - Offering blessings from the gods.
     - Grassing on your patrons concerning their taxes.

Other additions:

* Added calendar of eventful dates.
* Impossible quests are now more difficult.
* Creature re-sizing

notes.title: Beta Patch 0.9.2 - The Merfolk, and gifts.
notes.content:
This is quite a comprehensive patch which is still being heavily beta tested, however, we think we have most of the bugs well and truly squashed!

The Merfolk:

* Head underwater to build 'beds' for the Merfolk.
* New 'mer-themed' weapons and armour.
* New crafting items.
* New book explaining the Merfolk.
* New fishy enemies.
* New respawnable/forageable undersea area.

Gifts:

* Spouses will now leave you gifts.
* Happy patrons may also leave you gifts.

Other Stuff:

* Piety point cost displayed on spells.
* Scroll Icons changed.
* Scream sfx when companion dies.
* Text notification when companion dies.
* Various bugfixes.

notes.title: BETA patch 0.8.3 - Fixes and Rebalances
notes.content:
NEW:

* 2 new, cross-class, weapons added to tombs that can be entered under certain conditions
* Religious Portal - A new portal at Moonstone Tavern Shrine (once repaired) that allows access to a hidden chamber containing ways to spend piety.

BALANCES:

* Swords now do the most damage, followed by guns, then wands.
* Gun reload rate is increased.
* Less 'sprinting' enemies at all levels.

FIXES:

*  Whiskers ink icon now displays correctly.
* WASD input on number screens and shop screens fixed.

notes.title: BETA patch 0.8.2 - The Adventurers Market
notes.content:
The main content for this patch is an adventurers market held three times a month at the arena. The Market has very high prices but contains items not available except through quests!

Fixes:

*  Quests are no longer given when quest list is full.
*  No longer will it rain in Arcus.
*  Demise of the Lich book now works correctly.
*  Dragon Spawn made more easily available.
*  Full revive now restores 100% health.
*  Cleaning up sick now correctly restores renown.

notes.title: BETA patch 0.8 - Arena Patch
notes.content:
Patch 0.8 patch requires a game restart for the arena to work correctly.

The 0.8 patch includes:

 * New arena map with tri-monthly battle nights. 
    - Tavern fills up on arena days
    - Build special 'combatant' rooms to increase the number of combatants able to fight.
    - Stroll down to the arena and place a bet on the match.

  * Huge difficulty re-balances.
  * More personality types for enemy AI.
  * Prices lowered for hero-hire, pet fountain, other small things.
  * Quest tab added to main menu.
  * Bugfixes...
